name: kip
description: Kip — calm notes and private meeting notes, on your Mac.

scripts.web: npm --prefix ../web run build && rm -rf app && cp -R ../web/dist app

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kip listens to your meetings privately on this Mac to write your notes. Audio never leaves your device.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Kip hears your meeting app's audio privately on this Mac to transcribe it. Audio never leaves your device.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Kip reads text from slides shared in your meetings, privately on this Mac.
